summary: [standards] (open question 2, owner ruling) canon overrides the help and clears the value name of --commit and --plan-digest in the model (spec.rs reserved_standard) so the schema document names them bare, while --help keeps canon's own wording: --commit 'Act on the previewed plan; needs --plan-digest' against the standard 'Make the change; without it the command only previews.', --plan-digest <DIGEST> against the standard 'The digest of the preview this commit carries out.' with the default value name PLAN_DIGEST. The override leaks: the generated role-orchestrator guide now reads '--plan-digest <VALUE>' on five usage lines (artifacts move, ledger compact, migrate, purge, tier age) while the comment under each still says <DIGEST>, and the human 'canon schema purge' text lists '--plan-digest string' with no placeholder. Per the owner's ruling, put the standard texts (and the default value name PLAN_DIGEST) in the clap definitions of --commit and --plan-digest, so --help, the schema document, the guides and the human text agree, then delete reserved_standard and regenerate (just docs, the cli spec, conformance if a help line shows). Note the other reserved options (dry-run, limit, cursor, all) already keep canon's wording through a tree definition, which is the crate's sanctioned way; only commit and plan-digest need the standard text because the brief wants them listed by name on the five commands.
